speaker: Doctor
text: I see you've had fatigue, flank pain, and fever after treating acute sinusitis with antibiotics. To understand what might be happening, were the flank pains on one side or both, and does urinating make it worse?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
That is concerning, as these symptoms often persist if the initial antibiotic treatment was insufficient or if a different infection has developed. Was the antibiotic you took specifically for your sinus, or did you take a different medication for the pain? Also, have you noticed any changes in your urine, such as blood or difficulty urinating?
